p47_scoring.verdict: The refinery loop is measured end to end: stream -> surprise-selected harvest -> frozen hashed provenance-carrying file -> a stranger consumes it through a shock and comes out better than it went in -> every sampled source replays. The poisoning control separates at full exposure with content carrying ~half the benefit. What the loop does NOT yet show: content mediation on the recall axis (keyed reads from the file) and defense against poisoned content (the reader does not arbitrate; named as future work in the registration).
